items.question: First-order kinetics means the rate of elimination is?
items.explanation: In first-order kinetics a constant fraction is eliminated per unit time, so rate is proportional to concentration.

items.question: Tamsulosin is selective for which receptor?
items.explanation: Tamsulosin is a selective alpha-1A blocker used in BPH with less effect on blood pressure.

items.question: Context-sensitive half-time is most relevant for?
items.explanation: Context-sensitive half-time describes decline in plasma concentration after stopping a continuous infusion (e.g. propofol, remifentanil).

items.question: Pilocarpine is used in glaucoma because it is a?
items.explanation: Pilocarpine is a muscarinic agonist causing miosis and improved aqueous outflow, lowering intraocular pressure.

items.question: Phase 0 (microdosing) studies use?
items.explanation: Phase 0 uses sub-therapeutic microdoses in a few volunteers to study PK/PD early, before full Phase I.

*PharmaCraft Daily - 05 Oct 2026*

🎓 *MBBS* (General Pharmacology)
Q: First-order kinetics means the rate of elimination is?
Ans: Proportional to drug concentration
Why: In first-order kinetics a constant fraction is eliminated per unit time, so rate is proportional to concentration.

🩺 *NEET PG* (Autonomic Nervous System)
Q: Tamsulosin is selective for which receptor?
Ans: Alpha-1A
Why: Tamsulosin is a selective alpha-1A blocker used in BPH with less effect on blood pressure.

🏥 *INI-CET* (General Pharmacology)
Q: Context-sensitive half-time is most relevant for?
Ans: IV infused anaesthetics
Why: Context-sensitive half-time describes decline in plasma concentration after stopping a continuous infusion (e.g. propofol, remifentanil).

🌍 *FMGE* (Autonomic Nervous System)
Q: Pilocarpine is used in glaucoma because it is a?
Ans: Muscarinic agonist
Why: Pilocarpine is a muscarinic agonist causing miosis and improved aqueous outflow, lowering intraocular pressure.

🔬 *MD Pharmacology* (Clinical Trials)
Q: Phase 0 (microdosing) studies use?
Ans: Sub-therapeutic doses
Why: Phase 0 uses sub-therapeutic microdoses in a few volunteers to study PK/PD early, before full Phase I.
